dedupe_keys.name: traces geometriques des ports du systeme ers

description: Tracés géométriques des ports du système ERS is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Centre National de Surveillance des Pêches - CNSP. This dataset contains the tracings of the ports of the ERS system. This dataset was built from: - a dataset (A) provided by Global Fishing Watch of the anchorage areas detected in the AIS data - anchorage areas (B) detected in VMS data - manual additions of mooring points - geocoded positions of ERS ports ... Coverage: Centre National de Surveillance des Pêches - CNSP. The portal shows the English title as "Geometrical tracing of ERS ports" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Centre National de Surveillance des Pêches - CNSP. Its keywords include sig, ports. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2023-01-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
